facts.value: Loads Ground-provided LightList data into one runtime HSD_LObj chain, caches its head in lobj0 and an existing node selected by lb_8000CDC0 in lobj1. The latter is an alias, not a separately constructed filtered chain. Ground scaling precedes attachment to the lighting GObj; GX and process callbacks consume its full chain.
facts.rationale: Canonical selector returns an existing node and performs no allocation.

facts.value: Initializes the shared stage-derived lighting GObj for common fighter rendering, retaining the full runtime chain and a selected node alias, attaching the chain as light-kind payload, requesting frame-zero animation and registering animation and current-camera setup callbacks.
facts.rationale: Corrects filtered-copy terminology while preserving initialization purpose.

facts.value: Establishes stage-derived shared lighting used by common fighter rendering and ColorOverlay composition. Overlay helpers select all of lobj0 or only the selected lobj1 object before adding the separate Fighter light; restoration reinstalls lobj0.
facts.rationale: Active consumers establish the mapping without two-chain ownership claims.

facts.value: Canonical definition is void ftCo_8009F4A4(void). It returns no value and publishes a registered lighting GObj, a shared HSD_LObj chain head in lobj0 and a selected existing-node alias in lobj1. Its public header still uses UNK_RET and UNK_PARAMS.
facts.rationale: Preserves concrete signature while correcting persistent-output terminology.

facts.value: TU-local GX callback with canonical signature void ftCo_8009F54C(HSD_GObj* gobj, int code). The lighting GObj supplies an HSD_LObj chain through hsd_obj. code is ignored for every value.
facts.rationale: Corrects the claimed exact parameter spelling without changing the verified callback role.

evidence.why: Static declaration, attachment, registration and body.

facts.value: If selected-overlay x7C_flag2 is clear, returns without renderer mutation or dirty-bit clearing. Otherwise x2221_b3 gates only position/color/alpha refresh: light-enable true uses white RGB plus overlay alpha and sets LOBJ_ALPHA; false copies full overlay RGBA and clears it; refresh clears the dirty bit. Every active call, including clean calls, installs all lobj0 when light-enable is true or only lobj1 otherwise, inserts x588 and rebuilds current-camera lighting. No local finite-angle check or alpha-endpoint special case exists.
facts.rationale: Separates dirty-only cached refresh from every-active-call registry selection.

facts.value: Requires selected-overlay x7C_flag2 and x7C_light_enable. set_alpha true sets LOBJ_ALPHA and installs all lobj0; false clears it and installs only lobj1. Both insert x588 through HSD_LObjAddCurrent's deduplicating priority-ordered registry and rebuild current-camera lighting. No position/color refresh or Fighter dirty-bit update occurs here.
facts.rationale: Corrects tail-append wording and specifies limited mutations.

facts.value: Either overlay flag clear makes this helper a no-op. With both flags set, false clears LOBJ_ALPHA and selects only lobj1; true sets LOBJ_ALPHA and selects the entire lobj0 chain. Both paths insert the Fighter light into the priority-ordered current registry and immediately rebuild current-camera lighting without refreshing position/color or changing x2221_b3.
facts.rationale: Preserves verified state transitions while removing append ambiguity.

facts.value: Ground data produces one shared runtime chain cached as lobj0 and attached to a lighting GObj; lobj1 aliases a selected existing node. Local node2/node1/node0 data produces separate Fighter.x588. Selected ColorOverlay fields and root-model Y rotation drive dirty-gated position/color/alpha refresh. Active overlay paths combine x588 with all lobj0 or only lobj1 and rebuild current-camera lighting; restoration reinstalls all lobj0.
facts.rationale: Replaces two-produced-chain terminology with canonical resource flow.

facts.value: Fighter-rendering support TU declaring two static HSD_LObj pointers: lobj0 is a shared runtime chain head and lobj1 a selected existing-node alias. Static HSD_LightDesc and LightList wrappers seed separate Fighter.x588. These source roles do not prove compiled section placement or byte extents.
facts.rationale: Corrects two-independent-head characterization and preserves layout uncertainty.

facts.value: Shared animation and GX setup are independent of Fighter overlay flags. Overlay preparation/restoration require selected-overlay x7C_flag2; material mode also requires x7C_light_enable. The dirty bit gates only preparation's position/color/alpha refresh, not active-path base selection or camera setup. Mode selection changes alpha/base without refreshing position/color; restoration reinstalls lobj0 without resetting Fighter-light fields.
facts.rationale: Corrects the implication that all fighter lighting is inactive without an overlay.

facts.value: Fighter_GObj* gobj canonically; operationally the registered lighting GObj carrying the HSD_LObj chain in hsd_obj, not Fighter user data.
facts.rationale: Distinguishes declared type from payload role.

facts.value: HSD_GObj* gobj whose hsd_obj supplies the lighting chain used to replace the current collection.
int code; second GX callback argument, unused for every value.
facts.rationale: Complete body does not read code.

facts.value: Writable Fighter* fp receiving the loaded light in x588; previous field contents are overwritten without local release.
Fighter* fp supplying selected overlay state, root-model rotation, x588 light and x2221_b3 dirty bit; preparation can mutate the light and clear that bit.
Fighter* fp supplying selected ColorOverlay and x588; only light alpha flags and renderer-global lighting are conditionally changed here.
facts.rationale: Exact signature and limited side effects.

facts.value: bool set_alpha: with both overlay flags set, true sets LOBJ_ALPHA and selects all lobj0; false clears LOBJ_ALPHA and selects only lobj1, before inserting the Fighter light.
facts.rationale: Both Boolean branches and collection semantics verified.

facts.value: Fighter* fp read through ftCo_800C0658 only to test selected-overlay x7C_flag2; this helper writes no Fighter field.
facts.rationale: Accessor selects embedded state without mutation.
